Echoes of Change#000.src: Third Division - Guarding Sovereign Soosu's mansion.

Echoes of Change#003.src: The painting has a note attached to it.

Echoes of Change#004.src: Attend the meeting to prepare for the plan in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#004.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Steel Feather에서 작전 준비 회의에 참석하세요.

Echoes of Change#006.src: I trust everyone has taken the time to process last night's announcement? I will let Syndra take over shortly, but first, I would like to thank each and every one of you.
Echoes of Change#006.dst: 다들 어젯밤 발표를 충분히 곱씹어 보셨으리라 믿어요. 곧 Syndra에게 넘기겠지만, 먼저 한 분 한 분께 감사드리고 싶군요.
Echoes of Change#006.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#007.src: I won't mince words. This is dangerous work. What we are planning puts us at great risk. But this is what it takes to change Fruma, to put an end to the crown's oppression!
Echoes of Change#007.dst: 돌려 말하지 않겠습니다. 이건 위험한 일이에요. 우리 계획은 큰 위험을 안고 있죠. 하지만 Fruma를 바꾸고 왕실의 압제를 끝내려면 이 길뿐입니다!
Echoes of Change#007.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#008.src: We will kill a God! And we will all be free. Now, Syndra?
Echoes of Change#008.dst: 우리는 신을 죽일 겁니다! 그리고 모두 자유로워지겠죠. 자, Syndra?
Echoes of Change#008.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#009.src: Thank you, Quill. To begin, allow me to give each group their assignment.
Echoes of Change#009.dst: 고마워, Quill. 먼저 각 조에 임무를 나눠 줄게.
Echoes of Change#009.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#010.src: Mora and Yuman, you will be infiltrating the guards' outpost in {p} to retrieve their schedules. Get in, note down the formations, and get out.
Echoes of Change#010.dst: Mora와 Yuman, 너희는 {p}의 경비 초소에 잠입해서 근무표를 가져와. 들어가서 배치를 적고, 바로 나오는 거야.
Echoes of Change#010.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#011.src: Mora, you're familiar with military structure, and Yuman knows his way around {p}. I expect you two should be able to make it work.
Echoes of Change#011.dst: Mora는 군 조직을 잘 알고, Yuman은 {p} 지리에 밝지. 둘이면 해낼 수 있을 거라 믿어.
Echoes of Change#011.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#013.src: Understood. However, I have a few concerns with the overall plans... I'll speak with you later.
Echoes of Change#013.dst: 알겠다. 다만 전체 계획에 몇 가지 걱정이 있어... 나중에 따로 이야기하지.
Echoes of Change#013.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#014.src: Yusanu and Sui, you'll be constructing explosives that we can use as distractions during the festival to draw guards away from the main stage.
Echoes of Change#014.dst: Yusanu와 Sui, 너희는 폭발물을 만들어 줘. 축제 때 소동을 일으켜서 경비병을 본무대에서 떼어 놓는 데 쓸 거야.
Echoes of Change#014.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#015.src: I trust Yusanu knows what he's doing, so Sui, you'll be acting as an assistant.
Echoes of Change#015.dst: Yusanu는 잘 알아서 할 테니, Sui는 조수 역할을 맡아 줘.
Echoes of Change#015.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#017.src: Works for me. I might already have some blueprints lying around somewhere...
Echoes of Change#017.dst: 난 좋아. 어디 설계도도 좀 굴러다닐 것 같은데...
Echoes of Change#017.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#018.src: Zeph and Rex, I want you to scout the city rooftops for potential spots where Rex and Yulie can provide aerial support... in case it's necessary.
Echoes of Change#018.dst: Zeph와 Rex, 도시 옥상을 정찰해서 Rex와 Yulie가 공중 지원할 만한 자리를 찾아 줘... 혹시 필요할 때를 대비해서.
Echoes of Change#018.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#019.src: Yeah, I c- c- can do that.
Echoes of Change#019.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#021.src: Quill and Yulie, you two know your way around the city. I'll need you to scout out potential escape routes from the city... again, in case things go badly.
Echoes of Change#021.dst: Quill과 Yulie, 둘은 도시를 잘 알지. 도시에서 빠져나갈 탈출로를 찾아 줘... 이것도, 일이 틀어질 때를 대비해서.
Echoes of Change#021.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#022.src: Ah, that should be a breeze.
Echoes of Change#022.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#023.src: ...yes. I think I have a few places in mind already.
Echoes of Change#023.dst: ...응. 이미 몇 군데 생각해 둔 곳이 있어.
Echoes of Change#023.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#024.src: Finally. {u}, I want you to be adaptable. Help out wherever it's needed - I'm sure your skills will come in handy.
Echoes of Change#024.dst: 마지막으로. {u}, 넌 유연하게 움직여 줘. 필요한 곳 어디든 도와줘. 네 실력이라면 분명 쓸모가 있을 거야.
Echoes of Change#024.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#025.src: Hey, if you're helping out wherever, you should come with me and Mora! Guard positions would be handy to know before finding escape routes.
Echoes of Change#025.dst: 야, 어디든 돕는다면 나랑 Mora랑 같이 가자! 탈출로를 찾기 전에 경비 위치부터 알아 두면 좋잖아!
Echoes of Change#025.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#026.src: I was about to suggest the same thing. Then let us adjourn this meeting. Good luck, everyone.
Echoes of Change#026.dst: 나도 같은 제안을 하려던 참이야. 그럼 회의는 여기까지. 다들 행운을 빌어.
Echoes of Change#026.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#027.src: Hum. {u} and Yuman, let us go our plans then.
Echoes of Change#027.dst: 흠. {u}, Yuman, 그럼 우리 계획을 논의하지.
Echoes of Change#027.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#028.src: Meet up with Mora and Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#029.src: Alright, guys! So, any plans? What're we cooking with here?
Echoes of Change#029.dst: 좋아, 다들! 그래서 계획은? 우리 뭘로 요리할 건데?
Echoes of Change#029.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#031.src: Hey, man, everything good? I'm uh, not that horrible to work with, am I? Haha.
Echoes of Change#031.dst: 야, 괜찮아? 나 뭐, 같이 일하기 그렇게 최악은 아니지? 하하.
Echoes of Change#031.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#032.src: Ah! My apologies. No, it is not you... I simply do not like Syndra's plan.
Echoes of Change#032.dst: 아! 미안하다. 아니, 네 탓이 아니야... Syndra의 계획이 마음에 안 들 뿐이다.
Echoes of Change#032.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#033.src: You must understand, I would trust her with my life... but that is precisely the issue. She will do anything to avoid putting us in danger.
Echoes of Change#033.dst: 이해해 줘. 난 그녀에게 목숨도 맡길 수 있어... 하지만 바로 그게 문제다. 그녀는 우리를 위험에 빠뜨리지 않으려고 뭐든 할 거야.
Echoes of Change#033.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#034.src: She treats us as her own children, but she is only a decade older than I am! She would put herself through all the suffering in the world, if only to avoid letting us help where it is most needed!
Echoes of Change#034.dst: 그녀는 우리를 자기 자식처럼 대하지만, 나보다 겨우 열 살 많을 뿐이야! 가장 필요한 곳에서 우리가 돕지 못하게 하려고 세상의 온갖 고통을 혼자 짊어질 사람이지!
Echoes of Change#034.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#035.src: She is willing to take the fall if the plan goes awry. But, this time... this time, I will not back off. I am not allowing her to put herself through that danger alone.
Echoes of Change#035.dst: 계획이 틀어지면 그녀는 혼자 책임질 각오야. 하지만 이번에는... 이번에는 물러서지 않겠다. 그녀 혼자 그 위험을 감수하게 두지 않아.
Echoes of Change#035.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#036.src: Yeesh. Didn't think you guys were that messy! I think I get it though.
Echoes of Change#036.dst: 으. 너희가 그렇게 복잡한 사이인 줄 몰랐네! 그래도 무슨 말인지 알 것 같아.
Echoes of Change#036.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#037.src: My bros... they mean well, yeah, but they never ask for help. They're always trying to do everything themselves, and... and it drives me nuts!
Echoes of Change#037.dst: 우리 형들도... 좋은 뜻인 건 알아. 근데 절대 도움을 안 청해. 맨날 전부 혼자 하려고 하고... 그게 진짜 미치겠어!
Echoes of Change#037.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#038.src: Like, man, just let me do something!! Anything!! It's so frustrating.
Echoes of Change#038.dst: 아니, 나도 뭐 좀 하게 해 달라고!! 아무거나!! 진짜 답답해.
Echoes of Change#038.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#039.src: Ha! I did not think we had this in common. Well then... perhaps we can both prove ourselves to our families, eh?
Echoes of Change#039.dst: 하! 우리한테 이런 공통점이 있을 줄은. 그렇다면... 우리 둘 다 가족에게 증명해 보일 수 있겠지?
Echoes of Change#039.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#040.src: Yeah!! I like the sound of that!!
Echoes of Change#040.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#041.src: Okay, well, I know where the guards' outpost is in {p}. Let's just go to it and take it from there!
Echoes of Change#041.dst: 좋아, 그럼, {p}의 경비 초소 위치는 내가 알아. 일단 가 보고 거기서 생각하자!
Echoes of Change#041.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#042.src: Ha, settle down a little. I think we need to be a bit more prepared than that. But, yes, time is of the essence, so let us head there first. I will attempt to think of a plan on the way.
Echoes of Change#042.dst: 하, 좀 진정해. 그보다는 준비를 더 해야 할 것 같다. 하지만, 그래, 시간이 없으니 먼저 그리로 가자. 가는 길에 계획을 생각해 보지.
Echoes of Change#042.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#043.src: Whatever, man! Too much planning often spoils the results... but, sure! Let's meet outside the tallest building in {p}. First tunnel to the right leads there!
Echoes of Change#043.dst: 아무렴 어때! 계획이 너무 많으면 오히려 일을 망친다고... 뭐, 좋아! {p}에서 제일 높은 건물 밖에서 만나자. 오른쪽 첫 번째 터널로 가면 돼!
Echoes of Change#043.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#044.src: Meet up with Yuman and Mora in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#046.src: Good grief, this town's a mess. How does anyone live here?
Echoes of Change#046.dst: 맙소사, 이 동네 엉망이군. 여기서 어떻게 사는 거지?
Echoes of Change#046.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#047.src: Eh, ya get used to it. Here, follow me.
Echoes of Change#047.dst: 에, 살다 보면 익숙해져. 자, 따라와.
Echoes of Change#047.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#048.src: See, {p} utilizes all the space it has... stacking things atop each other. For example, this so-called "skyscraper" is mainly an apartment building!
Echoes of Change#048.dst: 봐, {p}은(는) 공간을 전부 활용해... 위로 층층이 쌓아 올리지. 예를 들어 이 "마천루"는 대부분 아파트야!
Echoes of Change#048.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#049.src: Then... what exactly are we doing here?
Echoes of Change#049.dst: 그럼... 우린 여기서 정확히 뭘 하는 거지?
Echoes of Change#049.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#050.src: I said mainly, man. The top floors serve as the offices for the local commander and constables. That's also why we've got to climb this staircase!
Echoes of Change#050.dst: "대부분"이라고 했잖아. 꼭대기 층은 이 지역 지휘관이랑 순경들 사무실이야. 그래서 이 계단을 올라가야 하는 거고!
Echoes of Change#050.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#051.src: Hope you guys are in shape!
Echoes of Change#051.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#053.src: Uh... we're on a mission, right? Trying to prove ourselves? Schedules are up there, so...
Echoes of Change#053.dst: 어... 우리 임무 중이잖아? 증명해 보이려고? 근무표가 위에 있으니까...
Echoes of Change#053.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#054.src: We cannot just... walk in there and grab the schedules! You do realize that, right? {u} and I are wanted by the crown! Even showing ourselves here at all is a risk.
Echoes of Change#054.dst: 그냥... 걸어 들어가서 근무표를 들고 나올 순 없어! 알고는 있는 거지? {u}와 나는 왕실의 수배자야! 여기 얼굴을 드러내는 것조차 위험하다.
Echoes of Change#054.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#055.src: Hey man, these soldiers see hundreds of people every day! If you don't give 'em a reason to pay attention, your faces won't stick out at all.
Echoes of Change#055.dst: 야, 저 병사들은 매일 수백 명을 봐! 주목할 이유만 안 주면 네 얼굴은 전혀 눈에 안 띌 거야.
Echoes of Change#055.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#056.src: Yuman, we were going to make a plan before rushing in. Did you forget about that?
Echoes of Change#056.dst: Yuman, 들이닥치기 전에 계획부터 세우기로 했잖나. 잊은 거야?
Echoes of Change#056.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#057.src: Riiight. Right. Sorry, I got excited. I am right, though - it wouldn't be hard for me to just talk us through this!
Echoes of Change#057.dst: 그래애. 맞아. 미안, 흥분했네. 그래도 내 말이 맞아 - 내가 말로 이 상황을 넘기는 건 어렵지 않을 거야!
Echoes of Change#057.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#058.src: This furnace seems to power the big crane...
Echoes of Change#058.dst: 이 용광로가 큰 크레인에 동력을 공급하는 것 같다...

Echoes of Change#059.src: Riiight. Right. Sorry, I got excited. I am right though - it wouldn't be hard for me to just talk us through this!
Echoes of Change#059.dst: 그래애. 맞아. 미안, 흥분했네. 그래도 내 말이 맞아 - 내가 말로 이 상황을 넘기는 건 어렵지 않을 거야!
Echoes of Change#059.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#060.src: Sigh... here, I have a better plan. Let us take some guard uniforms and put them on, and reach the schedules that way. We'll stand out even less, then.
Echoes of Change#060.dst: 하아... 더 좋은 계획이 있다. 경비병 제복을 구해서 입고, 그 모습으로 근무표에 접근하자. 그러면 더 눈에 안 띌 거야.
Echoes of Change#060.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#061.src: Ohh. A sneak mission! That's good. They should definitely have some spare uniforms in the tower... *and*, it should be pretty empty this time of day. Everyone's out patrolling.
Echoes of Change#061.dst: 오오. 잠입 임무! 좋은데. 탑에 여분 제복이 분명 있을 거야... *게다가*, 이 시간엔 거의 비어 있을걸. 다들 순찰 나갔거든.
Echoes of Change#061.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#062.src: So, good plan, man! I like it! Let's get to it!
Echoes of Change#062.dst: 그러니까, 좋은 계획이야! 마음에 들어! 가자!
Echoes of Change#062.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#063.src: Find guard uniforms inside of the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#063.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 경비 탑 안에서 경비병 제복을 찾으세요.

Echoes of Change#064.src: See? I told you, nobody's here!
Echoes of Change#064.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#065.src: Ha. I suppose I should have faith in your knowledge. My apologies.
Echoes of Change#065.dst: 하. 네 지식을 좀 더 믿었어야 했군. 미안하다.
Echoes of Change#065.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#066.src: ...ah, is that really all? I thought they would be harder to find.
Echoes of Change#066.dst: ...아, 정말 이게 다야? 찾기 더 어려울 줄 알았는데.
Echoes of Change#066.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#067.src: With how many guards have to come through here every day for uniform exchanges, this is just the easiest way. More efficient having it out here.
Echoes of Change#067.dst: 매일 제복 갈아입으러 오는 경비병이 얼마나 많은데, 이게 제일 편한 방법이지. 밖에 두는 게 더 효율적이고.
Echoes of Change#067.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#070.src: Oh, you are just going for it... I see. {u}, let's wait outside until he's done.
Echoes of Change#070.dst: 아, 바로 갈아입는 건가... 그렇군. {u}, 다 갈아입을 때까지 밖에서 기다리자.
Echoes of Change#070.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#071.src: Well? Thoughts? How do I look?
Echoes of Change#071.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#072.src: Like an average Roughworks soldier, I suppose.
Echoes of Change#072.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#075.src: Ah- haha, uh, n- nothin! Your turn!
Echoes of Change#075.dst: 아- 하하, 어, 아, 아무것도! 네 차례야!
Echoes of Change#075.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#076.src: This uniform is so... uncomfortable. And to think, I nearly signed up for this...
Echoes of Change#076.dst: 이 제복은 정말... 불편하군. 이런 걸 하마터면 지원할 뻔했다니...
Echoes of Change#076.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#077.src: Yeah, you'd think they'd complain about it more! But nah, they're all... stoic.
Echoes of Change#077.dst: 그치, 더 불평할 법도 한데! 근데 아냐, 다들... 무덤덤해.
Echoes of Change#077.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#078.src: Yes... well, {u}, it's your turn. Hurry, please. Someone could come up here at any time.
Echoes of Change#078.dst: 그래... 자, {u}, 네 차례다. 서둘러 줘. 언제든 누가 올라올 수 있어.
Echoes of Change#078.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#079.src: Find guard schedules inside the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#079.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 경비 탑 안에서 경비 근무표를 찾으세요.

Echoes of Change#080.src: Very well. Let us get this over with.
Echoes of Change#080.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#081.src: From what I heard from Yulie, the commander usually keeps the schedules in the top office. Let's get looking!
Echoes of Change#081.dst: Yulie한테 듣기론, 지휘관이 보통 근무표를 맨 위 사무실에 둔대. 찾아보자!
Echoes of Change#081.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#082.src: So, you? A soldier? What's the story there?
Echoes of Change#082.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#083.src: Sigh... the story is it was a choice between joining the military, and following in my parents' footsteps. And I did not especially want to do the latter.
Echoes of Change#083.dst: 하아... 사연이랄 건, 입대하느냐 부모님 뒤를 잇느냐의 선택이었지. 그리고 후자는 딱히 내키지 않았다.
Echoes of Change#083.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#085.src: They worked as woodcutters. A relatively common job in the {p}, but... I simply wanted to distance myself from them.
Echoes of Change#085.dst: 나무꾼이었다. {p}에선 꽤 흔한 일이지만... 난 그냥 부모님과 거리를 두고 싶었어.
Echoes of Change#085.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#086.src: The military seemed my best option... until I met Syndra, that is. Still... I regret I could not do more for Sui. She did not take my departure well.
Echoes of Change#086.dst: 군대가 최선으로 보였지... Syndra를 만나기 전까진. 그래도... Sui에게 더 해 주지 못한 게 후회된다. 내가 떠난 걸 힘들어했거든.
Echoes of Change#086.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#087.src: Hey, you were doing what was best for you, right? And it looks like you and Sui are all good now, so it turned out alright in the end.
Echoes of Change#087.dst: 야, 그땐 너한테 제일 좋은 선택을 한 거잖아? 지금은 Sui랑도 사이좋아 보이고, 결국 잘 풀린 거지.
Echoes of Change#087.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#089.src: Woah there! Eheh, sorry folks, didn't see-
Echoes of Change#089.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#090.src: Wait. You three - if you have your equipment, you should be out on the streets. State your business here.
Echoes of Change#090.dst: 잠깐. 너희 셋 - 장비를 챙겼으면 거리에 나가 있어야지. 여기서 뭘 하는지 말해.
Echoes of Change#090.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#091.src: ... Well? I'm not hearing an answer. State. Your. Business.
Echoes of Change#091.dst: ...뭐야? 대답이 안 들리는데. 용건을. 말해. 보라고.
Echoes of Change#091.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#092.src: I- ah. We... we were looking for...
Echoes of Change#092.dst: 나- 아. 우리는... 우리는 찾고 있었다...
Echoes of Change#092.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#095.src: Ya know how the stress gets. Festival's coming up, lots to worry about! Not getting much sleep - all that.
Echoes of Change#095.dst: 스트레스 알잖아요. 축제는 다가오고, 신경 쓸 게 산더미죠! 잠도 제대로 못 자고 - 뭐 그런 거.
Echoes of Change#095.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#096.src: Heck, I don't even remember what I last ate, hahaha!
Echoes of Change#096.dst: 어휴, 마지막으로 뭘 먹었는지도 기억이 안 나요, 하하하!
Echoes of Change#096.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#097.src: Ha! Yeah, I've been feeling that. Commander's got us working overtime, it's a whole mess.
Echoes of Change#097.dst: 하! 그렇지, 나도 요즘 그래. 지휘관이 초과 근무를 시켜서 완전 난장판이야.
Echoes of Change#097.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#098.src: Oh, hey, why don't y'all join us for some drinks after the shift?
Echoes of Change#098.dst: 오, 그래, 교대 끝나고 우리랑 한잔하러 갈래?
Echoes of Change#098.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#099.src: Sounds great, man! Guess we'll meet you boys then! You got the night shift too, right?
Echoes of Change#099.dst: 좋죠, 형님! 그럼 그때 봬요! 형님들도 야간 근무죠?
Echoes of Change#099.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#100.src: Yeah. Drew the short straw, unfortunately. The commander has us doing them the next few days...
Echoes of Change#100.dst: 그래. 운 나쁘게 걸렸지. 지휘관이 며칠 동안 야간을 시킨대...
Echoes of Change#100.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#101.src: At this rate, we'll be too damn tired to enjoy the festival! Like... give us a break, right?
Echoes of Change#101.dst: 이러다간 너무 지쳐서 축제를 즐기지도 못하겠어! 좀... 쉬게 좀 해 달라고, 안 그래?
Echoes of Change#101.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#102.src: Yeah, yeah. Same sorta thing here! I got paired up with these newbies, and the commander's got us on festival shift.
Echoes of Change#102.dst: 네, 네. 저희도 비슷해요! 이 신참들이랑 짝이 됐는데, 지휘관이 축제 근무를 시켰거든요.
Echoes of Change#102.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#103.src: Ouch. That's rough. Good luck out there.
Echoes of Change#103.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#104.src: Ey, thanks! But yeah, I'm still showin' them the ropes, and all that. We only got the news, like, an hour ago, so we're going to check the schedules.
Echoes of Change#104.dst: 헤, 고마워요! 아무튼 아직 이 친구들한테 일을 가르치는 중이에요. 한 시간 전에야 통보받아서 근무표 확인하러 가요.
Echoes of Change#104.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#105.src: Ah, management... putting newbies on festival shift? I wonder what the commander's thinking? Well, good luck with that.
Echoes of Change#105.dst: 아, 윗선이란... 신참을 축제 근무에 넣어? 지휘관은 무슨 생각인 거지? 뭐, 잘해 봐.
Echoes of Change#105.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#107.src: ...told ya I could talk us through it.
Echoes of Change#107.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#108.src: That was... impressive. I did not think it could be done.
Echoes of Change#108.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#109.src: Ah, y'know... they're still people at the end of the day.
Echoes of Change#109.dst: 아, 뭐... 결국 저 사람들도 사람이니까.
Echoes of Change#109.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#110.src: I... suppose. I apologize, I do not know why I... froze up there. I should know what I'm doing...
Echoes of Change#110.dst: 그런... 가 보군. 미안하다, 왜 거기서... 얼어붙었는지 모르겠어. 이런 건 잘 알아야 하는데...
Echoes of Change#110.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#111.src: Hey, it happens. For the record, I'm sorry for bein' a bit rough with ya. Had to convince them somehow.
Echoes of Change#111.dst: 야, 그럴 수도 있지. 그리고 아까 좀 거칠게 대해서 미안. 어떻게든 속여야 했거든.
Echoes of Change#111.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#112.src: No worries, Yuman, I understand. Now, ah... let us find the schedules before someone else notices we are not supposed to be here.
Echoes of Change#112.dst: 괜찮다, Yuman, 이해해. 자, 아... 여기 있으면 안 된다는 걸 누가 또 눈치채기 전에 근무표를 찾자.
Echoes of Change#112.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#114.src: The schedules were further up, yes?
Echoes of Change#114.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#116.src: Start writing them down, would you?
Echoes of Change#116.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#117.src: It's more guards than we typically see in Auburn festivals, that's for certain... I hope Syndra anticipated this.
Echoes of Change#117.dst: Auburn 축제 때 보통 보던 것보다 경비가 확실히 많군... Syndra가 이것까지 예상했길 바란다.
Echoes of Change#117.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#118.src: She seems like the kind of lady to have back-up plans for her back-up plans... I wouldn't worry too much.
Echoes of Change#118.dst: 그 사람은 예비 계획의 예비 계획까지 세워 둘 사람 같던데... 너무 걱정 안 해도 될 거야.
Echoes of Change#118.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#119.src: I suppose you're right. Now, we should make our way out of here before anyone else arrives.
Echoes of Change#119.dst: 네 말이 맞겠지. 자, 다른 사람이 오기 전에 여기서 나가자.
Echoes of Change#119.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#120.src: Return to The Steel Feather using the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find Yusanu and Sui.
Echoes of Change#120.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 터널로 The Steel Feather에 돌아가 Yusanu와 Sui를 찾으세요.

Echoes of Change#121.src: I could really use a nap after that.
Echoes of Change#121.dst: 이거 끝나고 낮잠 좀 자고 싶다.
Echoes of Change#121.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#122.src: Seems like our mission is done. Let's head back.
Echoes of Change#122.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#123.src: ...and we'll need to keep things calm back here while we're gone.
Echoes of Change#123.dst: ...그리고 우리가 없는 동안 이곳을 차분하게 유지해야 해.
Echoes of Change#123.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#124.src: Of course, of course. Wouldn't want anyone to panic.
Echoes of Change#124.dst: 물론, 물론이죠. 누구도 동요하면 안 되니까요.
Echoes of Change#124.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#125.src: I'm less concerned about panic, and more about stress. I know Quill will stay behind during the festival itself, but it'll be good to have additional help.
Echoes of Change#125.dst: 동요보다는 스트레스가 걱정이야. 축제 동안 Quill이 남아 있겠지만, 도움이 더 있으면 좋잖아.
Echoes of Change#125.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#126.src: Yes, ma'am. I can handle it.
Echoes of Change#126.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#128.src: Ah, I should get going. I'll see if I can track down Quill.
Echoes of Change#128.dst: 아, 전 이만 가 볼게요. Quill을 찾아볼게요.
Echoes of Change#128.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#131.src: Oh, Jiro was asking if there was anything he could do to help. I told him he could help Quill keep the peace down here while we're... performing the plan.
Echoes of Change#131.dst: 아, Jiro가 도울 일이 없냐고 묻더라. 우리가... 계획을 실행하는 동안 Quill과 함께 여기 질서를 지켜 달라고 했어.
Echoes of Change#131.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#132.src: He's... been acting a little out of character, truth be told... though it might just be the stress of the upcoming festival causing it.
Echoes of Change#132.dst: 사실... 요즘 좀 평소 같지 않아... 다가오는 축제 스트레스 때문일 수도 있지만.
Echoes of Change#132.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#133.src: But either way - how are things going?
Echoes of Change#133.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#134.src: That's good to hear. I know I placed a lot of responsibility on your shoulders...
Echoes of Change#134.dst: 다행이다. 너한테 너무 큰 책임을 지운 거 알아...
Echoes of Change#134.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#135.src: In truth, you have the most experience out of all the youngsters. And to ensure this plan succeeds... it's good to have you keep an eye on things.
Echoes of Change#135.dst: 사실, 젊은 애들 중에서 네가 경험이 제일 많아. 계획이 성공하려면... 네가 지켜봐 주는 게 좋아.
Echoes of Change#135.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#136.src: Mmn. I apologize for placing so much on your shoulders.
Echoes of Change#136.dst: 음. 너무 많은 짐을 지워서 미안해.
Echoes of Change#136.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#137.src: But you have the most experience out of all the youngsters, and we need to ensure this plan works... we have no choice.
Echoes of Change#137.dst: 하지만 젊은 애들 중에 네 경험이 제일 많고, 이 계획은 꼭 성공해야 해... 다른 방법이 없어.
Echoes of Change#137.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#138.src: But, regardless - Mora gave me the guard positions you retrieved. I was working with Rex and Zeph on our next steps, based off that information.
Echoes of Change#138.dst: 아무튼 - Mora가 너희가 가져온 경비 배치를 줬어. Rex, Zeph와 그걸 바탕으로 다음 단계를 짜던 중이었어.
Echoes of Change#138.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#139.src: They've gone off... somewhere, I don't know where. Until they return, you should go see if Sui and Yusanu need anything.
Echoes of Change#139.dst: 그 둘은... 어딘가로 갔어, 어딘지는 몰라. 돌아올 때까지 Sui와 Yusanu에게 필요한 게 있는지 가 봐 줘.
Echoes of Change#139.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#140.src: Until Rex and Zeph return, you should go see if Sui and Yusanu need anything.
Echoes of Change#140.dst: Rex와 Zeph가 돌아올 때까지 Sui와 Yusanu를 좀 도와줘.
Echoes of Change#140.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#141.src: Oh! {u}, you're back! How did it, um, go?
Echoes of Change#141.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#142.src: Oh! Good! It, um, went smoothly, I hope? Mora and Yuman got along?
Echoes of Change#142.dst: 오! 다행이다! 음, 순조로웠지? Mora랑 Yuman은 잘 지냈어?
Echoes of Change#142.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#143.src: If they got the schedules, it was probably fine. So, {u}, are you here to help us out too?
Echoes of Change#143.dst: 근무표를 가져왔으면 괜찮았겠지. 그래서, {u}, 너도 우릴 도와주러 온 거야?
Echoes of Change#143.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#144.src: Hehe, I guess that's what happens when you show off all those skills of yours!
Echoes of Change#144.dst: 헤헤, 그런 실력을 뽐내면 이렇게 되는 거지!
Echoes of Change#144.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#145.src: Yep! Oh, speaking of... {u}, are you here to help us out too?
Echoes of Change#145.dst: 그렇지! 아, 그러고 보니... {u}, 너도 우릴 도와주러 온 거야?
Echoes of Change#145.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#146.src: We've been putting together those explosives Syndra requested. I think we've decided on an easily produced model.
Echoes of Change#146.dst: Syndra가 부탁한 폭발물을 만들고 있었어. 쉽게 만들 수 있는 모델로 정한 것 같아.
Echoes of Change#146.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#147.src: By, um, "we," he mostly means him. I can, ha, barely understand what he's going on about.
Echoes of Change#147.dst: 음, "우리"라고 해도 거의 얘 혼자야. 난, 하, 무슨 말인지 거의 못 알아듣겠어.
Echoes of Change#147.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#148.src: Hey, don't sell yourself short! You've been helpful! I would've never thought to utilize water in the design if it weren't for your suggestion.
Echoes of Change#148.dst: 야, 자신을 깎아내리지 마! 도움 많이 됐어! 네 제안 아니었으면 설계에 물을 쓸 생각은 절대 못 했을 거야.
Echoes of Change#148.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#149.src: Oh... thank you. {u}, we were playing around with the idea of hiding magical water inside the, um, explosive... but I, ah, don't know how to hold its power when I can't... see it.
Echoes of Change#149.dst: 아... 고마워. {u}, 마법의 물을, 음, 폭발물 안에 숨기는 걸 시험해 보고 있었는데... 난, 어, 안 보이면 그 힘을 붙잡는 법을 몰라서.
Echoes of Change#149.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#151.src: Magic or not, using water in the design will make the explosion look more dangerous and powerful than it actually is! It's genius!
Echoes of Change#151.dst: 마법이든 아니든, 물을 쓰면 폭발이 실제보다 더 위험하고 강력해 보일 거야! 천재적이지!
Echoes of Change#151.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#152.src: Now, we just need to put it together...
Echoes of Change#152.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#153.src: Eheh. Maybe? I need to run some tests while it's being assembled, and Sui needs to stand guard in case it's about to actually explode.
Echoes of Change#153.dst: 에헤. 아마도? 조립하는 동안 난 테스트를 좀 해야 하고, Sui는 진짜 터질 때를 대비해 지켜봐야 해.
Echoes of Change#153.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#154.src: If things go awry, I'll, um, surround it in a ball of water.
Echoes of Change#154.dst: 잘못되면, 음, 물 덩어리로 감싸 버릴게.
Echoes of Change#154.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#155.src: Yep! Okay, no more questions, we've got to get to it! Click the explosive parts whenever you're ready.
Echoes of Change#155.dst: 그렇지! 좋아, 질문은 그만, 작업하자! 준비되면 폭발물 부품을 클릭해.
Echoes of Change#155.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#156.src: Help assemble the explosives inside the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#157.src: (Coal Block): Can only be placed on the outer tiles.
Echoes of Change#157.dst: (석탄 블록): 바깥쪽 칸에만 놓을 수 있습니다.
Echoes of Change#157.speaker: Casing

Echoes of Change#158.src: (Dark Gray Concrete Powder): Can only be placed on the inner tiles.
Echoes of Change#158.dst: (회색 콘크리트 가루): 안쪽 칸에만 놓을 수 있습니다.
Echoes of Change#158.speaker: Gunpowder

Echoes of Change#159.src: (White Wool Block): Must touch the orange chemical.
Echoes of Change#159.speaker: Fuse

Echoes of Change#161.src: (Bone): Can remove any block from the board.
Echoes of Change#161.speaker: Wrench

Echoes of Change#162.src: Collect all pieces by finishing {~} puzzles!
Echoes of Change#162.speaker: Bomb Piece

Echoes of Change#164.src: I think Sui and I will perform a few more tests... maybe a test run or two... but the construction went okay, so I should be able to produce some more.
Echoes of Change#164.dst: Sui랑 난 테스트를 몇 번 더 할 거야... 시험 폭발도 한두 번... 그래도 조립은 괜찮았으니 더 만들 수 있을 거야.
Echoes of Change#164.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#165.src: And, eheh, hopefully not blow up my workshop...
Echoes of Change#165.dst: 그리고, 에헤, 작업장은 안 날려 먹으면 좋겠네...
Echoes of Change#165.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#166.src: Oh, no... {u}, are you sure you, um, can't stick around, a bit longer? Just, in case?
Echoes of Change#166.dst: 아, 안 돼... {u}, 정말, 음, 조금만 더 있으면 안 돼? 그냥, 혹시 모르니까?
Echoes of Change#166.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#167.src: Nope, there's still stuff to do! On that subject - {u}, Rex was looking for you earlier.
Echoes of Change#167.dst: 안 돼, 아직 할 일이 남았어! 그 얘기가 나와서 말인데 - {u}, 아까 Rex가 찾더라.
Echoes of Change#167.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#168.src: Meet up with Zeph and Rex for the next assignment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#168.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 Zeph와 Rex를 만나 다음 임무를 받으세요.

Echoes of Change#169.src: {u}, finally! There you are! I was getting restless.
Echoes of Change#169.dst: {u}, 드디어! 거기 있었구나! 좀이 쑤시던 참이야.
Echoes of Change#169.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#170.src: I w- was quite comfortable... actually.
Echoes of Change#170.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#171.src: Oh, are the nerves getting to you Zeph?
Echoes of Change#171.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#172.src: I- I know... But it f- fe- feels like everyone else is doing okay, while I- I'm not even doing an- any- anything, and I'm a- al- already panicking.
Echoes of Change#172.dst: 아, 알아... 그런데 다들 잘하고 있는 것 같은데, 나, 나만 아, 아무것도 안 했는데 벌써 겁, 겁이 나.
Echoes of Change#172.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#173.src: Hey, everyone else is also feeling nervous, Zeph. Some of us are just... better at hiding it than others.
Echoes of Change#173.dst: 야, 다들 긴장하고 있어, Zeph. 그냥 몇몇이... 남들보다 잘 숨길 뿐이지.
Echoes of Change#173.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#174.src: Re- really? For some reason, that m- ma- makes me feel a lot better... uh, n- no offense!
Echoes of Change#174.dst: 지, 진짜? 왠지 그 말 들으니까 훨, 훨씬 낫다... 어, 기, 기분 나빠하지 마!
Echoes of Change#174.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#175.src: We're all nervous, Zeph. It's a risky plan. But we know what we're doing. We have to trust we'll succeed.
Echoes of Change#175.dst: 우리 다 긴장했어, Zeph. 위험한 계획이니까. 하지만 우린 뭘 하는지 알아. 성공할 거라고 믿어야 해.
Echoes of Change#175.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#176.src: Ha ha, v- ver- very funny, {u}. I- I- I'm trying. I am! It's just... hard not to be an- anxious.
Echoes of Change#176.dst: 하하, 차, 참 재밌네, {u}. 나, 나, 나도 노력 중이야. 진짜로! 그냥... 불, 불안하지 않기가 어려워.
Echoes of Change#176.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#177.src: You're fine, Zeph. I'd be surprised if you weren't anxious, honestly. Given what we're planning on doing...
Echoes of Change#177.dst: 넌 괜찮아, Zeph. 솔직히 불안하지 않으면 그게 더 놀랍지. 우리가 하려는 일을 생각하면...
Echoes of Change#177.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#178.src: I g- guess... It's all just st- st- starting to sink in.
Echoes of Change#178.dst: 그, 그렇겠지... 이제야 실, 실감이 나기 시작했어.
Echoes of Change#178.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#179.src: Look, the more you think about it, the worse it'll get. Accept the feeling for what it is, then put it aside for now.
Echoes of Change#179.dst: 봐, 생각할수록 더 나빠져. 그 감정을 그대로 받아들이고, 일단 옆에 치워 둬.
Echoes of Change#179.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#180.src: We've got work to do, and... we really can't afford to screw it up.
Echoes of Change#180.dst: 할 일이 있고... 절대 망치면 안 되거든.
Echoes of Change#180.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#182.src: That's all I ask. Anyway, {u}, Zeph and I looked over the schedules with Syndra earlier. We've marked a couple of spots we want to check out.
Echoes of Change#182.dst: 그거면 돼. 아무튼, {u}, 아까 Zeph랑 Syndra와 근무표를 봤어. 확인하고 싶은 곳을 몇 군데 표시해 뒀지.
Echoes of Change#182.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#183.src: So- s- so let's go see them in person! Uh, Rex, I c- ca- can carry the arrows and electric ch- charges for you.
Echoes of Change#183.dst: 그, 그럼 직접 가 보자! 어, Rex, 화살이랑 전기 충, 충전탄은 내, 내가 들게.
Echoes of Change#183.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#185.src: ...and those are the faces I usually see around, so-
Echoes of Change#185.dst: ...그리고 그게 내가 평소에 보는 얼굴들이야, 그러니까-
Echoes of Change#185.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#186.src: Ah- Rex, Zeph, and {u}! Rather auspicious timing.
Echoes of Change#186.dst: 아- Rex, Zeph, 그리고 {u}! 마침 좋은 때에 왔군요.
Echoes of Change#186.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#187.src: Oh. hey! Have you seen the guard schedules yet?
Echoes of Change#187.dst: 오, 안녕! 경비 근무표는 벌써 봤어?
Echoes of Change#187.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#188.src: We have, yep. Quill and I were just talking about some of the escape routes I had in mind.
Echoes of Change#188.dst: 응, 봤어. Quill이랑 내가 생각해 둔 탈출로 얘기를 하던 참이야.
Echoes of Change#188.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#189.src: Are you heading out for your assignment then?
Echoes of Change#189.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#190.src: We were j- just about to head to {p} for ours, too. P- per- perhaps we could go there together?
Echoes of Change#190.dst: 우, 우리도 막 {p}(으)로 가려던 참이야. 가, 같이 가면 어때?
Echoes of Change#190.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#191.src: Hmm... yes, I suppose we could- though, I'll want {u}'s opinion on our ideas as well. Once you finish with Rex and Zeph, would you care to join us?
Echoes of Change#191.dst: 음... 그래요, 그래도 되겠죠- 다만 우리 구상에 대한 {u}의 의견도 듣고 싶네요. Rex와 Zeph 일이 끝나면 합류해 줄래요?
Echoes of Change#191.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#192.src: Then let's get going. No time to waste.
Echoes of Change#192.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#193.src: Find Zeph and Rex in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#194.src: Rex, please don't pick the highest rooftops.
Echoes of Change#194.dst: Rex, 제발 제일 높은 옥상은 고르지 마.
Echoes of Change#194.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#195.src: You better not pick out the highest roof tops. I'm not sure I can get up that far.
Echoes of Change#195.dst: 제일 높은 옥상은 고르지 마. 거기까지 올라갈 자신이 없어.
Echoes of Change#195.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#196.src: I'm just not sure I'd be able to climb up to them.
Echoes of Change#196.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#197.src: Well, Yuman seems to do it just fine! But okay, I'll pick out something more accessible for you.
Echoes of Change#197.dst: 뭐, Yuman은 잘만 올라가던데! 그래도 알았어, 너한테 좀 더 오르기 쉬운 데로 고를게.
Echoes of Change#197.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#199.src: Hm... {u}, I don't suppose you would happen to have seen Jiro?
Echoes of Change#199.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#200.src: Syndra told me he had gone looking for me, but I haven't seen him all day!
Echoes of Change#200.dst: Syndra 말로는 날 찾으러 갔다는데, 하루 종일 못 봤어요!
Echoes of Change#200.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#201.src: Well, I suppose I can always find him after we're done here. No need to delay this any longer.
Echoes of Change#201.dst: 뭐, 여기 일이 끝나고 찾으면 되겠죠. 더 미룰 필요는 없어요.
Echoes of Change#201.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#202.src: Just one more day... a- a- and then it'll be done. I can m- make it that far.
Echoes of Change#202.dst: 하루만 더... 그, 그러면 끝이야. 거기까진 버, 버틸 수 있어.
Echoes of Change#202.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#203.src: T- took you a bit, huh?
Echoes of Change#203.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#204.src: Great! You're here! Slowpoke. I thought Zeph's races in the {p} would've prepared you for this!
Echoes of Change#204.dst: 좋아! 왔구나! 느림보. {p}에서 Zeph랑 경주한 덕에 이 정도는 익숙할 줄 알았는데!
Echoes of Change#204.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#205.src: Quill and Yulie? They've started on their assignment already. Quill said to tell you to just join up with them once you're done here.
Echoes of Change#205.dst: Quill이랑 Yulie? 벌써 임무 시작했어. 여기 일 끝나면 그쪽에 합류하라고 Quill이 전해 달래.
Echoes of Change#205.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#206.src: Ha! Or m- ma- maybe you're too slow!
Echoes of Change#206.dst: 하! 아, 아니면 네가 너무 느린 거지!
Echoes of Change#206.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#207.src: We should get started, before we draw any attention towards ourselves... I've got the map here. Zeph and I have marked out two locations.
Echoes of Change#207.dst: 시선 끌기 전에 시작하자... 지도는 나한테 있어. Zeph랑 내가 두 군데를 표시해 뒀어.
Echoes of Change#207.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#208.src: We're ch- checking both, since we wanted to sp- split Rex and Yulie on two different v- vantage points.
Echoes of Change#208.dst: 두, 둘 다 확인할 거야. Rex랑 Yulie를 서로 다른 두 저, 전망 지점에 나, 나눠 두고 싶거든.
Echoes of Change#208.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#209.src: I'll p- point them out for you. Ready?
Echoes of Change#209.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#211.src: Always a second with you... fine, just let us know when you are ready.
Echoes of Change#211.dst: 넌 늘 한 박자 늦지... 됐어, 준비되면 말해.
Echoes of Change#211.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#213.src: And there's the s- sec- second one!
Echoes of Change#213.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#214.src: Okay. Let's g- get to work!
Echoes of Change#214.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#215.src: Here, Zeph, hand me those arrows. Keep the charges though, I think your point would be better for Yulie.
Echoes of Change#215.dst: 자, Zeph, 화살 줘. 충전탄은 네가 갖고 있어. 네 자리가 Yulie한테 더 맞을 것 같아.
Echoes of Change#215.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#216.src: Sure... w- wait, why do we need {u} for this?
Echoes of Change#216.dst: 그래... 자, 잠깐, 이거에 {u}이(가) 왜 필요해?
Echoes of Change#216.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#217.src: To check our work, I guess? They can help assess the vantage points. Maybe they'll spot some potential issues we missed.
Echoes of Change#217.dst: 우리 작업을 확인하려고, 아마? 전망 지점을 평가해 줄 수 있잖아. 우리가 놓친 문제를 찾을지도 몰라.
Echoes of Change#217.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#219.src: Just make your way up however you can!
Echoes of Change#219.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#220.src: Get to the top of the two buildings at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#221.src: Yeah, hey. Not much fer conversation today, 'm afraid.
Echoes of Change#221.dst: 어, 안녕. 오늘은 얘기할 기분이 아니구먼.
Echoes of Change#221.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#222.src: This job's gonna be the death a' me eventually. If it's not slippin off the ledge, 's gonna be breakin' my damn back.
Echoes of Change#222.dst: 이 일이 결국 날 잡을 거여. 난간에서 미끄러지든가, 아니면 허리가 박살 나든가.
Echoes of Change#222.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#223.src: Beggars can't be choosers though, huh? Literally, in my case...
Echoes of Change#223.dst: 그래도 거지가 찬밥 더운밥 가리겠어? 내 경우엔 말 그대로지만...
Echoes of Change#223.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#225.src: Ha! Well, o- of course I am! I can't let y- you start beating me... I ha- have an image to maintain!
Echoes of Change#225.dst: 하! 다, 당연하지! 네가 날 이기게 둘 순 없어... 나, 나도 체면이 있다고!
Echoes of Change#225.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#226.src: B- but you didn't! Maybe next time... wh- what are we at now? Zeph {~}... {u} {~}?
Echoes of Change#226.dst: 그, 그치만 못 이겼잖아! 다음에 해 봐... 지, 지금 몇 대 몇이더라? Zeph {~}... {u} {~}?
Echoes of Change#226.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#227.src: Ha... so, th- this is the spot.
Echoes of Change#227.dst: 하... 그, 그래서 여기가 그 자리야.
Echoes of Change#227.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#228.src: This should c- co- cover Rex's blind spots well enough...
Echoes of Change#228.dst: 여기면 Rex의 사각지대를 충, 충분히 커버할 거야...
Echoes of Change#228.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#229.src: What do you th- think? Does it look okay?
Echoes of Change#229.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#230.src: Perfect! So are we g- good then?
Echoes of Change#230.dst: 좋았어! 그럼 이, 이제 된 거지?
Echoes of Change#230.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#231.src: Well... I- I guess it is a little high up for Y- Yulie... but I think it's fine.
Echoes of Change#231.dst: 음... 나, Y, Yulie한테는 좀 높을 수도 있겠지만... 괜찮을 것 같아.
Echoes of Change#231.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#232.src: Let me p- put down the equipment here...
Echoes of Change#232.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#233.src: Hey... if you h- hurry, you can make it to the other spot be- before Rex does!
Echoes of Change#233.dst: 야... 서, 서두르면 Rex보다 머, 먼저 다른 자리에 갈 수 있어!
Echoes of Change#233.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#234.src: She's n-never been the most agile...
Echoes of Change#234.dst: 걔는 워, 원래 몸이 가볍진 않거든...
Echoes of Change#234.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#235.src: Uh, d- don't tell her I said that!!!
Echoes of Change#235.dst: 어, 내, 내가 그랬다고 말하지 마!!!
Echoes of Change#235.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#237.src: I saw you beat R- Rex earlier! Not like that's hard, th- though!
Echoes of Change#237.dst: 아까 R, Rex 이기는 거 봤어! 뭐, 어, 어려운 일도 아니지만!
Echoes of Change#237.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#238.src: But since we're done here... it's t- time for you to assist Quill and Yulie, Superhero.
Echoes of Change#238.dst: 그래도 여기 일은 끝났으니... 이제 Quill이랑 Yulie를 도, 도울 차례야, 슈퍼히어로.
Echoes of Change#238.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#239.src: ...heh. I- I should go get some more pr- practice in, though... before tomorrow.
Echoes of Change#239.dst: ...헤. 나, 난 내일 전에... 여, 연습 좀 더 하러 가야겠다.
Echoes of Change#239.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#240.src: Quill and Yulie are out- outside Sovereign Soosu's mansion, by the way.
Echoes of Change#240.dst: 그리고 Quill이랑 Yulie는 Soosu 군주 저택 바, 바깥에 있어.
Echoes of Change#240.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#241.src: I'll be there in a second!
Echoes of Change#241.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#242.src: Phew... well, seems like you got here before me.
Echoes of Change#242.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#243.src: Oh. Thanks. But you've seen me do better!
Echoes of Change#243.dst: 아. 고마워. 그래도 내가 더 잘하는 것도 봤잖아!
Echoes of Change#243.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#244.dst: 흥. 그래, 알 게 뭐야. 그래서 뭐?
Echoes of Change#244.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#245.src: Hm... would you agree this spot overlooks the whole square?
Echoes of Change#245.dst: 음... 여기서 광장 전체가 내려다보인다는 데 동의해?
Echoes of Change#245.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#246.src: From what I've heard, the festival always takes place right here. And this looks like it gives us a pretty good coverage of the area...
Echoes of Change#246.dst: 듣기로는 축제가 항상 바로 여기서 열린대. 그리고 여기라면 주변을 꽤 넓게 커버할 수 있을 것 같아...
Echoes of Change#246.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#248.src: Just... okay? You're sure? If you have any concerns, speak up.
Echoes of Change#248.dst: 그냥... 괜찮다고? 확실해? 걱정되는 게 있으면 말해.
Echoes of Change#248.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#249.src: ...no? You're just gonna go mute? Okay. Sure.
Echoes of Change#249.dst: ...없어? 그냥 입 다물고 있겠다고? 그래. 알았어.
Echoes of Change#249.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#250.src: Really? Well, if you say so.
Echoes of Change#250.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#251.src: I guess that means our work here is done!
Echoes of Change#251.dst: 그럼 여기 일은 끝난 것 같네!
Echoes of Change#251.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#252.src: Just gotta leave the equipment here...
Echoes of Change#252.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#253.src: Alright! That's my part done, but you've still got to assess Zeph's location.
Echoes of Change#253.dst: 좋아! 내 몫은 끝났어. 그래도 Zeph 쪽 자리도 평가해 줘야 해.
Echoes of Change#253.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#254.src: I'll head down and wait for him to be done. I'll see you back at the Steel Feather, I guess.
Echoes of Change#254.dst: 난 내려가서 Zeph가 끝날 때까지 기다릴게. 그럼 Steel Feather에서 보자.
Echoes of Change#254.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#255.src: Good luck with Quill and Yulie. That's the last bit of preparation we have to do, right?
Echoes of Change#255.dst: Quill이랑 Yulie 쪽도 잘해. 그게 우리가 할 마지막 준비지?
Echoes of Change#255.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#257.src: Alright! That's my part done... and I saw you over with Zeph earlier, too.
Echoes of Change#257.dst: 좋아! 내 몫은 끝났어... 그리고 아까 Zeph 쪽에 있는 것도 봤어.
Echoes of Change#257.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#258.src: So I think that means we're done. I'll go get Zeph and head back to the Steel Feather.
Echoes of Change#258.dst: 그럼 우린 다 끝난 것 같네. 난 Zeph 데리고 Steel Feather로 돌아갈게.
Echoes of Change#258.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#259.src: I need to get some practice in before tomorrow... I know the plan shouldn't involve any fighting, but... in case things go wrong, I need to be sure I can hit my shots when it counts.
Echoes of Change#259.dst: 내일 전에 연습 좀 해야겠어... 계획상 싸울 일은 없어야 하지만... 일이 틀어지면 결정적인 순간에 확실히 맞혀야 하니까.
Echoes of Change#259.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#260.src: I think I saw Quill and Yulie out by Sovereign Soosu's mansion. So, go find them! Don't keep them waiting!
Echoes of Change#260.dst: Soosu 군주 저택 근처에서 Quill이랑 Yulie를 본 것 같아. 그러니까 가서 찾아! 기다리게 하지 말고!
Echoes of Change#260.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#262.src: Ah, {u}! I take it you have finished up with Rex and Zeph?
Echoes of Change#262.dst: 아, {u}! Rex와 Zeph 일은 끝났나 보군요?
Echoes of Change#262.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#263.src: We've been trying to get an idea of the general feel of the coming festival.
Echoes of Change#263.dst: 다가오는 축제 분위기가 대충 어떤지 파악하려던 중이야.
Echoes of Change#263.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#264.src: As with every year, people usually just see it as a day off of work. That's all it really is for them.
Echoes of Change#264.dst: 매년 그렇듯이 사람들은 그냥 일 안 하는 날로 여겨. 그들에겐 그게 전부야.
Echoes of Change#264.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#265.src: Rather different from what you had experienced in the {p}, yes? The people there see their festival as a way to celebrate their culture.
Echoes of Change#265.dst: {p}에서 겪었던 것과는 꽤 다르죠? 그곳 사람들은 축제를 자기 문화를 기리는 방법으로 여기니까요.
Echoes of Change#265.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#266.src: Hm... that's hard to imagine. Though, in a way, I guess the Roughworks festival also celebrates our culture... just, only the part of it about working hard.
Echoes of Change#266.dst: 음... 상상하기 어렵네. 그래도 어떤 의미로는 Roughworks 축제도 우리 문화를 기리는 거겠지... 그냥 열심히 일하는 부분만.
Echoes of Change#266.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#267.src: Indeed... indeed. Well, as we are all here, let us begin the task. According to the map, we have three possible escape routes to scout out.
Echoes of Change#267.dst: 그렇죠... 그렇고말고요. 자, 다 모였으니 시작합시다. 지도에 따르면 살펴볼 탈출로 후보가 세 곳이에요.
Echoes of Change#267.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#268.src: And they're the ones most likely to be optimal, with the information from the guard schedules... alright. Let's head to the first location then.
Echoes of Change#268.dst: 그리고 경비 근무표 정보로 보면 가장 적합할 만한 곳들이야... 좋아. 그럼 첫 번째 장소로 가자.
Echoes of Change#268.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#270.src: First on the list... our tunnel.
Echoes of Change#270.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#271.src: The reason it's been so safe for us all this time is 'cause the place is always empty.
Echoes of Change#271.dst: 지금까지 우리가 이렇게 안전했던 건 이곳이 늘 비어 있어서야.
Echoes of Change#271.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#272.src: It's still a developing area in the city, so people rarely come here.
Echoes of Change#272.dst: 아직 개발 중인 구역이라 사람들이 거의 안 와.
Echoes of Change#272.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#273.src: And according to our guard schedules... it should remain unguarded during the festival, as well.
Echoes of Change#273.dst: 그리고 경비 근무표에 따르면... 축제 동안에도 여긴 경비가 없을 거예요.
Echoes of Change#273.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#274.src: {u}, why don't you have a look around?
Echoes of Change#274.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#275.src: Assess the first escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#280.src: Why are you even here? Don't you have work to do? Tomorrow is a VERY special day.
Echoes of Change#280.dst: 여긴 대체 왜 온 거야? 할 일 없어? 내일은 아주 특별한 날이라고.
Echoes of Change#280.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#282.src: Well LUCKY you!!!!!! But SOME of us have work to do!!!!! What do you want?!
Echoes of Change#282.dst: 좋겠네 아주!!!!!! 근데 누구는 일해야 하거든!!!!! 뭘 원하는데?!
Echoes of Change#282.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#283.src: Thoughts? You interrupted my work to ask about my THOUGHTS?
Echoes of Change#283.dst: 생각? 내 일을 방해하고 내 생각을 묻는다고?
Echoes of Change#283.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#284.src: I mean... if you really want to know. It's great! A day of NO work. You know what that means!
Echoes of Change#284.dst: 뭐... 정 알고 싶다면. 최고지! 일 안 하는 하루. 무슨 뜻인지 알지!
Echoes of Change#284.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#285.src: I get to dust off my Roughworks Vodka and not worry for {~} hours! Great days ahead, I tell ya!
Echoes of Change#285.dst: 내 Roughworks 보드카 먼지 털고 {~}시간 동안 아무 걱정 안 해도 된다고! 좋은 날이 오는 거지!
Echoes of Change#285.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#286.src: Have a look around, {u}. Perhaps you'll find something which compromises this option.
Echoes of Change#286.dst: 둘러보세요, {u}. 이 경로에 문제가 될 만한 걸 찾을지도 몰라요.
Echoes of Change#286.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#288.src: Hm... seems fine, all things considered. Let's get to the next option. It's on the other side of the city.
Echoes of Change#288.dst: 음... 따져 보면 괜찮은 것 같아. 다음 후보로 가자. 도시 반대편에 있어.
Echoes of Change#288.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#289.src: Head to the second escape point at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#290.src: Hm... the map tells me it should be around here somewhere, but... Yulie?
Echoes of Change#290.dst: 음... 지도상으론 이 근처 어딘가인데... Yulie?
Echoes of Change#290.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#291.src: Right, this one. The plan was to escape using the underground river.
Echoes of Change#291.dst: 맞아, 여기. 지하 강을 이용해 탈출하는 계획이었어.
Echoes of Change#291.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#292.src: This path should lead us to it, I think.
Echoes of Change#292.dst: 이 길로 가면 거기 나올 거야.
Echoes of Change#292.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#294.src: It... might require us to, ah, dive through a small underwater section.
Echoes of Change#294.dst: 이게... 물속 구간을 조금, 어, 잠수해서 지나야 할 수도 있어.
Echoes of Change#294.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#296.src: Look, it's perfectly safe! Mostly. I've tried it before, it works!
Echoes of Change#296.dst: 봐, 완전 안전해! 대체로. 전에 해 봤는데 돼!
Echoes of Change#296.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#297.src: Oh, dear. Do I want to know why?
Echoes of Change#297.dst: 이런. 왜 해 봤는지 알아야 할까요?
Echoes of Change#297.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#298.src: Work stuff... an investigation led me to it. A thief had used it to escape the city- it's not important.
Echoes of Change#298.dst: 일 때문에... 수사하다 알게 됐어. 도둑이 여길로 도시를 빠져나갔거든- 중요한 건 아니고.
Echoes of Change#298.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#299.src: I see. Let's mark this one as our lowest priority. Only to be used in case of emergencies.
Echoes of Change#299.dst: 그렇군요. 이곳은 최하순위로 표시하죠. 비상시에만 쓰는 걸로.
Echoes of Change#299.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#300.src: But it would be worth taking a look around, either way. {u}, maybe you'll find something.
Echoes of Change#300.dst: 그래도 한번 둘러볼 가치는 있어요. {u}, 뭔가 찾을지도 모르죠.
Echoes of Change#300.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#301.src: Assess the second escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#302.src: Bless you, child. I hope her Majesty brings you health.
Echoes of Change#302.dst: 축복을, 얘야. 폐하께서 네게 건강을 내려 주시길.
Echoes of Change#302.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#303.src: Her Majesty sure is powerful. And tomorrow... it's her big day.
Echoes of Change#303.dst: 여왕 폐하는 정말 강하시지. 그리고 내일은... 폐하의 큰날이야.
Echoes of Change#303.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#304.src: And I get to see her! Bless us all.
Echoes of Change#304.dst: 폐하를 직접 뵐 수 있어! 모두에게 축복을.
Echoes of Change#304.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#307.src: Do you like how I have decorated my palace. And my most priced posetion... my own personal symbol of her Majesty of Fruma!
Echoes of Change#307.dst: 내가 내 궁전을 꾸민 게 마음에 드니. 그리고 내 가장 소중한 보물... Fruma의 여왕 폐하를 상징하는 나만의 물건!
Echoes of Change#307.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#308.src: She is great, don't you agree. And all that she has done for us, her children.
Echoes of Change#308.dst: 폐하는 위대하시지, 안 그러니. 우리, 폐하의 자녀들을 위해 해 주신 모든 것도.
Echoes of Change#308.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#309.src: Unfortunately I am a bad subject, a very very bad subject! I couldn't work due to my illness... And... I lost my original home - the much worse version.
Echoes of Change#309.dst: 안타깝게도 난 나쁜 신민이야, 아주아주 나쁜 신민! 병 때문에 일을 못 했지... 그리고... 원래 집을 잃었어 - 훨씬 나쁜 집이었지.
Echoes of Change#309.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#310.src: This home is much more homely.
Echoes of Change#310.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#312.src: That was my own fault for being lazy and worthless. But now! Now I've devoted myself to her Majesty.
Echoes of Change#312.dst: 그건 게으르고 쓸모없던 내 잘못이야. 하지만 이제! 이제 난 폐하께 몸 바쳤어.
Echoes of Change#312.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#313.src: She is the reason I'm alive and well! She even cured my mental illness. I feel much better now.
Echoes of Change#313.dst: 폐하 덕분에 내가 건강히 살아 있는 거야! 마음의 병까지 고쳐 주셨지. 이제 훨씬 나아.
Echoes of Change#313.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#314.src: It's absolutely splendid! A whole day of getting to celebrate her majesty... Nothing could beat that.
Echoes of Change#314.dst: 정말 근사하지! 하루 종일 폐하를 기릴 수 있다니... 그보다 좋은 건 없어.
Echoes of Change#314.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#315.src: Every festival brings me closer to her. I even feel like I will soon join her in the capital!
Echoes of Change#315.dst: 축제 때마다 폐하께 더 가까워져. 곧 수도에서 폐하 곁에 설 것만 같아!
Echoes of Change#315.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#316.src: Join her as her right hand by the throne!
Echoes of Change#316.dst: 옥좌 곁에서 폐하의 오른팔이 될 거야!
Echoes of Change#316.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#319.src: Hah... Since when did you tu - turn - turn into two people!
Echoes of Change#319.dst: 하... 너 언제 두, 둘, 두 명이 됐냐!
Echoes of Change#319.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#320.src: Well yeees... Of course it is! *hic*
Echoes of Change#320.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#321.src: Do - d- do you like it? Smells quite freshhhh.
Echoes of Change#321.dst: 마, 마, 마음에 들어? 냄새 아주 상큼하지이.
Echoes of Change#321.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#322.src: Oh I feel like I ne- need to... hurl... *burp*
Echoes of Change#322.dst: 아 나 좀... 토할... 것 같... *꺽*
Echoes of Change#322.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#324.src: Oh! That one... Ya know, I don't even know what year it is anymore.
Echoes of Change#324.dst: 아! 그거... 있잖아, 이젠 올해가 몇 년인지도 모르겠어.
Echoes of Change#324.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#325.src: None of of it matters anymore. This is my life n-now!
Echoes of Change#325.dst: 이젠 다 사, 상관없어. 이게 이제 내 인생이야!
Echoes of Change#325.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#326.src: But it would be worth taking a look around, either way. {u}, maybe you'll find something.
Echoes of Change#326.dst: 그래도 한번 둘러볼 가치는 있어요. {u}, 뭔가 찾을지도 모르죠.
Echoes of Change#326.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#327.src: Wow... When did your twin appear?
Echoes of Change#327.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#328.src: Wow... When did your twin appear?
Echoes of Change#328.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#329.src: Alright... to the final spot, then. The gate to the {p}.
Echoes of Change#329.dst: 좋아... 그럼 마지막 장소로. {p}(으)로 가는 관문이야.
Echoes of Change#329.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#330.src: Head to the third escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#331.src: Sigh... our last stop. That wall, always looming over me...
Echoes of Change#331.dst: 하아... 마지막 장소군요. 저 벽은 늘 날 내려다보고 있죠...
Echoes of Change#331.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#333.src: Yes, yes. I'm alright. {u}... is something on your mind?
Echoes of Change#333.dst: 네, 네. 괜찮아요. {u}... 무슨 생각 하고 있어요?
Echoes of Change#333.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#334.src: Ah... yes. I understand your meaning.
Echoes of Change#334.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#335.src: But... we do not have the space to house all of these people. No matter how much I wish we could.
Echoes of Change#335.dst: 하지만... 이 사람들을 모두 받아 줄 공간이 없어요. 아무리 그러고 싶어도요.
Echoes of Change#335.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#336.src: Some of these people also refuse to accept our help. They're too deeply rooted in the Roughworks' work culture.
Echoes of Change#336.dst: 게다가 우리 도움을 거부하는 사람도 있어. Roughworks의 노동 문화에 너무 깊이 물들었거든.
Echoes of Change#336.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#337.src: I was one of them, once. My brothers and I, we used to live around there. After... well, we didn't have anywhere else to go.
Echoes of Change#337.dst: 나도 한때 그중 하나였어. 형제들이랑 저 근처에 살았지. 그 뒤로... 뭐, 달리 갈 데가 없었어.
Echoes of Change#337.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#338.src: When Quill offered to take us off the street, I... almost declined the offer. I didn't need his pity, I thought. I was supporting our family just fine.
Echoes of Change#338.dst: Quill이 거리에서 데려가 주겠다고 했을 때... 거절할 뻔했어. 동정 따윈 필요 없다고 생각했지. 가족은 내가 잘 먹여 살리고 있었으니까.
Echoes of Change#338.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#339.src: ...but I remembered our parents. How our mother worked three jobs just to keep our house. How even those jobs weren't enough, and eventually... she fell ill.
Echoes of Change#339.dst: ...그런데 부모님이 떠올랐어. 엄마가 집을 지키려고 일을 세 개나 했던 거. 그래도 모자라서, 결국... 병이 나셨던 거.
Echoes of Change#339.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#341.src: I realized... that was where I was heading. Working myself to death, and- and for what? Then they'd be left on their own anyway.
Echoes of Change#341.dst: 깨달았지... 내가 그 길로 가고 있다는 걸. 죽도록 일하다가- 대체 뭘 위해? 결국 형제들만 남겨질 텐데.
Echoes of Change#341.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#342.src: For what it is worth, I am deeply glad you chose to come with me, Yulie.
Echoes of Change#342.dst: 보탬이 될지 모르지만, 당신이 나와 함께해 줘서 정말 기뻐요, Yulie.
Echoes of Change#342.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#343.src: ...yeah. It's hard accepting help when you're in that position, is all. It's easier to turn to substances to keep working, to survive...
Echoes of Change#343.dst: ...응. 그런 처지면 도움을 받아들이기가 힘들 뿐이야. 계속 일하고 살아남으려고 약에 기대는 게 더 쉽거든...
Echoes of Change#343.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#344.src: But that's what we're doing all this for, isn't it? To build a better Fruma.
Echoes of Change#344.dst: 그래도 우리가 이 모든 걸 하는 이유가 그거잖아? 더 나은 Fruma를 만들려고.
Echoes of Change#344.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#345.src: ...hm. I believe someone is about to pass through the gate.
Echoes of Change#345.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#346.src: What? More guards for the festival? Or-
Echoes of Change#346.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#347.src: I'm not certain, Yulie. But we should avoid being spotted.
Echoes of Change#347.dst: 확실하진 않아요, Yulie. 하지만 들키지 않는 게 좋겠어요.
Echoes of Change#347.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#349.src: You're the newest addition to our set, then. Good punctuality- You've made a good first impression.
Echoes of Change#349.dst: 그럼 자네가 우리 팀의 최신 멤버군. 시간 엄수 좋아- 첫인상이 아주 좋아.
Echoes of Change#349.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#350.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I was... told I would be meeting Sovereign Soosu here?
Echoes of Change#350.dst: Zhiraok 군주님. 여기서... Soosu 군주님을 뵙는다고 들었는데요?
Echoes of Change#350.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#351.src: Attention to formalities is good too, but no need to stand on ceremony right now, alright? Soosu, we'll meet in a short while.
Echoes of Change#351.dst: 격식을 챙기는 것도 좋지만, 지금은 예의 차릴 필요 없어, 알았지? Soosu는 곧 만날 거야.
Echoes of Change#351.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#352.src: But as for you- Tasim, correct? This'll be your first time visiting {p}? It's the province's central hub for technological development. Needs work, but what do you think?
Echoes of Change#352.dst: 그런데 자네- Tasim, 맞지? {p}은(는) 처음인가? 이 지방의 기술 개발 중심지야. 손볼 데는 많지만, 어때?
Echoes of Change#352.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#353.src: It is, yes...ah, to both your questions. I don't think I've ever seen anything this... densely packed! It definitely leaves an impression.
Echoes of Change#353.dst: 네, 맞아요... 아, 두 질문 다요. 이렇게... 빽빽한 곳은 처음 봐요! 확실히 인상적이네요.
Echoes of Change#353.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#354.src: I, ah... appreciate the help getting adjusted to all this. I'm still getting used to... holding this authority, I guess. I'm not sure I'm comfortable having the soldiers defer to me yet.
Echoes of Change#354.dst: 저, 아... 적응을 도와주셔서 감사해요. 아직... 이런 권한을 갖는 게 익숙하지 않아서요. 병사들이 제 말을 따르는 게 아직 좀 불편해요.
Echoes of Change#354.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#355.src: I was in the same position as you once too. {~} years seems long, especially to me, but compared to the rest? I'm barely on the board. You'll get used to it, so don't worry.
Echoes of Change#355.dst: 나도 한때 자네랑 같은 처지였어. {~}년이면 길어 보이지, 특히 나한텐. 근데 다른 이들에 비하면? 난 이제 막 명함 내민 수준이야. 곧 익숙해질 테니 걱정 마.
Echoes of Change#355.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#356.src: On that tangent... How's your recovery been? I remember how taxing ascension was for me... But you look like you're taking to it naturally.
Echoes of Change#356.dst: 그 얘기가 나와서... 회복은 어때? 승천이 나한테 얼마나 힘들었는지 기억나... 그런데 자넨 자연스럽게 적응하는 것 같군.
Echoes of Change#356.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#357.src: I'm getting there. The blessing's a little strange, but it's not unlike what I was already able to do. I just need to practice using it.
Echoes of Change#357.dst: 나아지고 있어요. 축복이 좀 낯설지만, 원래 제가 할 수 있던 것과 크게 다르진 않아요. 쓰는 연습만 하면 돼요.
Echoes of Change#357.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#358.src: Golden! I know how tough being the newest can be, so don't be afraid to ask me if you need help solving for your own problems.
Echoes of Change#358.dst: 훌륭해! 막내가 얼마나 힘든지 아니까, 자네 문제를 푸는 데 도움이 필요하면 언제든 물어봐.
Echoes of Change#358.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#359.src: Speaking of... How's that project you were scouted for? Her Majesty and the Spymaster haven't shown their work to the rest of the class yet.
Echoes of Change#359.dst: 그러고 보니... 자네가 발탁된 그 프로젝트는 어때? 여왕 폐하와 첩보단장이 아직 우리한테 결과물을 공유 안 했거든.
Echoes of Change#359.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#360.src: I've been filled in on the details already, but Her Majesty wants me to fully recover before we start.
Echoes of Change#360.dst: 세부 사항은 이미 들었지만, 시작 전에 완전히 회복하라는 여왕 폐하의 명이에요.
Echoes of Change#360.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#361.src: I can tell you more later. You said you'd be able to bring me to Sovereign Soosu?
Echoes of Change#361.dst: 나중에 더 말씀드릴게요. Soosu 군주님께 데려다주신다고 하셨죠?
Echoes of Change#361.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#362.src: I'll put a pin in that, then. I think she'll be reaching the end of her sequence on whatever she was working on by now... Follow me, her mansion's this way.
Echoes of Change#362.dst: 그럼 그 얘긴 보류하지. 지금쯤 그녀가 하던 작업의 시퀀스가 끝나 갈 거야... 따라와, 저택은 이쪽이야.
Echoes of Change#362.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#363.src: Talk to Yulie and Quill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#365.src: Indeed... we already had two Sovereigns to concern ourselves with. And now, a third.
Echoes of Change#365.dst: 그러게요... 이미 신경 쓸 군주가 둘이나 있었는데. 이제 셋이네요.
Echoes of Change#365.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#366.src: He's not one of the Sovereigns I know about... is he new?
Echoes of Change#366.dst: 내가 아는 군주는 아니야... 새로 온 건가?
Echoes of Change#366.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#367.src: Perhaps... but this could be a problem. We know nothing about this new Sovereign...
Echoes of Change#367.dst: 아마도요... 하지만 문제가 될 수 있어요. 새 군주에 대해 아는 게 전혀 없으니...
Echoes of Change#367.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#369.src: Hm... no, Syndra would have mentioned him if he were from the {p}.
Echoes of Change#369.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#370.src: You have Sovereign friends...? Why? How?
Echoes of Change#370.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#371.src: There could be any number of explanations... but it does not matter.
Echoes of Change#371.dst: 여러 사정이 있을 수 있겠죠... 하지만 중요하지 않아요.
Echoes of Change#371.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#372.src: If you know him, we need information. What can you tell us?
Echoes of Change#372.dst: 그를 안다면 정보가 필요해요. 무슨 얘기를 해 줄 수 있죠?
Echoes of Change#372.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#373.src: Really. Because from my perspective, working directly under the Crown doesn't sound like something a good person would do!
Echoes of Change#373.dst: 그래? 내가 보기엔 왕실 밑에서 직접 일하는 건 좋은 사람이 할 짓이 아니거든!
Echoes of Change#373.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#374.src: That could certainly be a concern... though, we were not expecting to fight any Sovereigns, regardless.
Echoes of Change#374.dst: 그건 분명 걱정거리일 수 있죠... 어쨌든 우린 군주와 싸울 계획은 없었지만요.
Echoes of Change#374.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#375.src: Ah... so you knew him before his ascension, then.
Echoes of Change#375.dst: 아... 그럼 승천하기 전부터 알던 사이군요.
Echoes of Change#375.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#376.src: This could be a good thing for us. If he only recently ascended, he's likely to lack experience with the Queen's blessing.
Echoes of Change#376.dst: 우리에겐 좋은 일일 수도 있어요. 최근에 승천했다면 여왕의 축복을 다루는 경험이 부족할 테니까요.
Echoes of Change#376.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#377.src: We need to report back to Syndra about this... this changes things.
Echoes of Change#377.dst: Syndra에게 이걸 보고해야 해... 상황이 달라졌어.
Echoes of Change#377.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#378.src: Come on, let's head back to the Steel Feather.
Echoes of Change#378.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#380.src: If it comes down to it... and you are forced to face him. Would you be ready to kill your former friend, if necessary?
Echoes of Change#380.dst: 만약 정말 그렇게 돼서... 그와 맞서야 한다면. 필요할 때 옛 친구를 죽일 각오가 되어 있나요?
Echoes of Change#380.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#381.src: ...think on it, for now. If we are lucky, you won't need the answer.
Echoes of Change#381.dst: ...지금은 생각만 해 둬요. 운이 좋다면 답이 필요 없을 테니까.
Echoes of Change#381.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#382.src: Return to The Steel Feather and discuss the final steps at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#382.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 The Steel Feather로 돌아가 마지막 단계를 논의하세요.

Echoes of Change#383.src: Everyone! Gather around, we return with... news. Both good and bad.
Echoes of Change#383.dst: 여러분! 모여 주세요, 소식을... 가져왔어요. 좋은 것과 나쁜 것 둘 다.
Echoes of Change#383.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#384.src: Welcome back. I hesitate to ask, but what are the news?
Echoes of Change#384.dst: 잘 돌아왔어. 묻기 망설여지지만, 무슨 소식이야?
Echoes of Change#384.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#385.src: We can begin with the good news. We have properly assessed each of our escape routes, and ordered them from most to least preferable..
Echoes of Change#385.dst: 좋은 소식부터 하죠. 탈출로를 모두 제대로 평가했고, 선호도 순으로 정리해 뒀어요.
Echoes of Change#385.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#386.src: That's good. With that, we should have completed all the necessary preparations for the festival... then what are the bad news?
Echoes of Change#386.dst: 좋아. 이로써 축제 준비는 다 끝난 셈이네... 그럼 나쁜 소식은?
Echoes of Change#386.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#387.src: We've learned of a third Sovereign who will be present at the festival. A new one, by the name of Tasim.
Echoes of Change#387.dst: 축제에 세 번째 군주가 참석한다는 걸 알았어요. Tasim이라는 신참이에요.
Echoes of Change#387.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#388.src: Oh, great. As if having both Sovereigns Zhiraok and Soosu to deal with wasn't bad enough... and now there's another one?
Echoes of Change#388.dst: 와, 잘됐네. Zhiraok 군주랑 Soosu 군주 둘을 상대하는 것도 벅찬데... 이제 하나 더?
Echoes of Change#388.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#389.src: This doesn't change anything. We'll proceed as planned.
Echoes of Change#389.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#390.src: Er... with all due respect, we'd stand no chance facing three Sovereigns wielding the Queen's blessing. I doubt we could even defeat one!
Echoes of Change#390.dst: 어... 외람되지만, 여왕의 축복을 휘두르는 군주 셋이면 우리에겐 승산이 없어. 하나라도 이길 수 있을지 의문이야!
Echoes of Change#390.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#391.src: We have all the necessary steps prepared. We know what we need to do. The plan doesn't involve facing the Sovereigns at all - the only target is Her Majesty.
Echoes of Change#391.dst: 필요한 단계는 다 준비됐어. 할 일도 알고 있고. 계획엔 군주와 싸우는 일 자체가 없어 - 목표는 오직 여왕 폐하야.
Echoes of Change#391.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#392.src: Syndra... I agree with the young ones. It's incredibly risky, and the risk factor has only increased. Perhaps we... wait for next year?
Echoes of Change#392.dst: Syndra... 나도 젊은이들과 같은 생각이에요. 너무 위험한데, 위험은 더 커지기만 했어요. 차라리... 내년을 기다리면?
Echoes of Change#392.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#394.src: Yes, the outlook of this fight is not great. Yes, the odds are against us. As I have said previously, I will be the face of the operation.
Echoes of Change#394.dst: 그래, 이 싸움의 전망은 좋지 않아. 그래, 승산도 낮아. 전에 말했듯이 이 작전의 얼굴은 나야.
Echoes of Change#394.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#395.src: I will deal the final blow, and I alone will draw the wrath of the crown and the people. The rest of you will work from the shadows. No one will even know you're involved.
Echoes of Change#395.dst: 마지막 일격은 내가 날리고, 왕실과 백성의 분노도 나 혼자 받을 거야. 나머지는 그늘에서 움직여. 너희가 관여했단 것조차 아무도 모를 거야.
Echoes of Change#395.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#396.src: Syndra, old friend... are you certain your judgement isn't... clouded? I understand your troubled history, I do... but is it worth burning yourself to ash? What would Eli-
Echoes of Change#396.dst: Syndra, 오랜 친구여... 판단이 흐려진 건... 아닌가요? 당신의 괴로운 과거는 이해해요, 정말로... 하지만 자신을 재가 되도록 태울 만한 일인가요? Eli가 뭐라고-
Echoes of Change#396.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#397.src: Enough, Quill. My judgment is clear. I do not believe an additional Sovereign changes anything. Now, are you still ready to proceed?
Echoes of Change#397.dst: 그만해, Quill. 내 판단은 확실해. 군주 하나 늘었다고 달라질 건 없어. 자, 다들 아직 진행할 준비됐어?
Echoes of Change#397.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#398.src: ... Well, the explosives are already made and ready... so I guess we might as well use 'em.
Echoes of Change#398.dst: ...뭐, 폭발물은 이미 다 만들어 놨으니... 쓰는 게 낫겠지.
Echoes of Change#398.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#400.src: After seeing the state of our citizens today... we've waited long enough. I'm ready to take action.
Echoes of Change#400.dst: 오늘 우리 시민들 상태를 보고 나니... 기다릴 만큼 기다렸어. 행동할 준비됐어.
Echoes of Change#400.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#401.src: So long as Zeph joins, I'm in.
Echoes of Change#401.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#402.src: Wh- what? Why w- wo- would my choice matter to you...? Uh, an- anyway, I already pr- pro- promised to help Syndra, no m- matter what.
Echoes of Change#402.dst: 뭐, 뭐? 내 선택이 왜 너한테 주, 중요한데...? 어, 아, 아무튼, 난 무슨 일이 있어도 Syndra를 돕기로 이, 이미 약속했어.
Echoes of Change#402.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#403.src: Sigh. Fine, I'm outvoted. But I don't like this.
Echoes of Change#403.dst: 하아. 좋아, 다수결에 졌네. 그래도 마음에 안 들어.
Echoes of Change#403.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#406.src: I am fighting. But I will not allow you to take the fall for it entirely by yourself.
Echoes of Change#406.dst: 나는 싸우겠다. 하지만 그 책임을 전부 혼자 지게 두진 않겠어.
Echoes of Change#406.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#407.src: You don't need to protect me, Mora. This is my decision, and-
Echoes of Change#407.dst: 날 지킬 필요 없어, Mora. 이건 내 결정이고-
Echoes of Change#407.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#408.src: And my decision, Syndra, is to follow you into battle.
Echoes of Change#408.dst: 그리고 내 결정은, Syndra, 너를 따라 전장에 가는 거다.
Echoes of Change#408.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#411.src: That will be all I ask from most of you. Try to rest and relax before tomorrow's festival. I'll do a final briefing before we head out in the morning.
Echoes of Change#411.dst: 대부분에겐 이게 다야. 내일 축제 전까지 푹 쉬어. 아침에 출발하기 전에 마지막 브리핑을 할게.
Echoes of Change#411.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#412.src: {u}, I have one final request to make of you. I'd like to duel you again... this time, I'll give it my all, and I expect the same of you.
Echoes of Change#412.dst: {u}, 너한테 마지막 부탁이 하나 있어. 다시 한번 결투하고 싶어... 이번엔 전력을 다할 테니, 너도 그래 줘.
Echoes of Change#412.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#413.src: Meet me by the north-eastern tracks.
Echoes of Change#413.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#414.src: My water magic has gotten a lot better. I will help, no matter what!
Echoes of Change#414.dst: 내 물 마법 많이 늘었어. 무슨 일이 있어도 도울 거야!
Echoes of Change#414.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#416.src: U-uh, yeah. I was just a-about to go there myself.
Echoes of Change#416.dst: 어, 어, 그래. 나도 마, 막 가려던 참이야.
Echoes of Change#416.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#417.src: I- I can't rest now. I n-need to practice.
Echoes of Change#417.dst: 나, 난 지금 못 쉬어. 여, 연습해야 해.
Echoes of Change#417.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#418.src: All things considered, I am excited to find out how my explosives will perform.
Echoes of Change#418.dst: 이것저것 따져 봐도, 내 폭발물이 어떤 성능을 낼지 기대돼.
Echoes of Change#418.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#420.src: I hope Yus' tech doesn't let me down...
Echoes of Change#420.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#421.src: I have a really bad feeling about tomorrow. Syndra better know what she's doing.
Echoes of Change#421.dst: 내일은 정말 느낌이 안 좋아. Syndra가 제대로 알고 하는 거길 바란다.
Echoes of Change#421.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#422.src: Resistance will always come with a cost. I just hope the cost isn't too great.
Echoes of Change#422.dst: 저항에는 언제나 대가가 따른다. 그 대가가 너무 크지 않길 바랄 뿐이야.
Echoes of Change#422.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#423.src: Meet up with Syndra for your duel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#424.src: We don't know what tomorrow will hold. We might succeed without any issues - and I really, truly hope that'll be the case.
Echoes of Change#424.dst: 내일 무슨 일이 생길지 몰라. 아무 문제 없이 성공할지도 모르지 - 진심으로 그렇게 되길 바라.
Echoes of Change#424.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#425.src: However... We need to be ready for anything. That's why I want to challenge you.
Echoes of Change#425.dst: 하지만... 무슨 일이든 대비해야 해. 그래서 너에게 도전하려는 거야.
Echoes of Change#425.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#426.src: Of everyone here, you and I are the closest to the power level of a Sovereign. If we can each hold our own in this duel... we might stand a chance.
Echoes of Change#426.dst: 여기 모두 중에 군주의 힘에 가장 가까운 건 너와 나야. 이 결투에서 둘 다 버틸 수 있다면... 승산이 있을지도 몰라.
Echoes of Change#426.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#427.src: As I said, I won't be holding back. I expect you to do the same.
Echoes of Change#427.dst: 말했듯이 봐주지 않을 거야. 너도 그래 줘.
Echoes of Change#427.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#428.src: ... I haven't told you the most important part of my plan yet, have I?
Echoes of Change#428.dst: ...내 계획의 가장 중요한 부분은 아직 말 안 했지?
Echoes of Change#428.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#429.src: I've said that I'll deal the final blow on Her Majesty. In order to do that... I will use my blessing from above, and kill her in one strike.
Echoes of Change#429.dst: 여왕 폐하께 마지막 일격을 날리겠다고 했지. 그러기 위해... 위에서 받은 축복을 써서, 단 한 번에 죽일 거야.
Echoes of Change#429.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#430.src: I'll let everyone else know tomorrow morning... But do you understand why I need this duel? I... I need to be certain I can do it.
Echoes of Change#430.dst: 다른 사람들에겐 내일 아침에 알릴 거야... 그래도 내가 왜 이 결투가 필요한지 알겠지? 난... 할 수 있다는 확신이 필요해.
Echoes of Change#430.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#431.src: Alright. When you're ready, speak to me again, and we shall proceed.
Echoes of Change#431.dst: 좋아. 준비되면 다시 말을 걸어. 그때 시작하자.
Echoes of Change#431.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#434.src: Alright. Let the best soldier win!
Echoes of Change#434.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#436.src: Truthfully, I didn't expect to be able to best you. You've been able to hone your skills and train your magic far more than I ever could have.
Echoes of Change#436.dst: 솔직히 너를 이길 거라곤 생각 안 했어. 넌 내가 할 수 있었던 것보다 훨씬 더 기술을 연마하고 마법을 단련했으니까.
Echoes of Change#436.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#437.src: So many years... and the solution was right in front of me. But I didn't know to look!
Echoes of Change#437.dst: 그 오랜 세월... 답이 바로 눈앞에 있었는데. 볼 줄을 몰랐어!
Echoes of Change#437.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#438.src: ...it doesn't matter now. We've come this far already. We'll have to work with what we have.
Echoes of Change#438.dst: ...이제 상관없어. 이미 여기까지 왔어. 가진 걸로 해내야지.
Echoes of Change#438.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#439.src: Listen... there is one other reason I asked for this. I have... something of a hard truth I need to share, and I need you to keep it to yourself.
Echoes of Change#439.dst: 들어 봐... 이걸 부탁한 이유가 하나 더 있어. 털어놔야 할... 힘든 진실이 있는데, 너만 알고 있어 줘.
Echoes of Change#439.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#440.src: There is a significant chance I will fail to land the initial strike. If that happens... I will not make it out of that confrontation alive.
Echoes of Change#440.dst: 첫 일격을 실패할 가능성이 꽤 커. 그렇게 되면... 그 대결에서 난 살아 나오지 못할 거야.
Echoes of Change#440.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#441.src: A battle with Her Majesty is no fight at all. How could it be? Could any one person make a dent in such overwhelming strength?
Echoes of Change#441.dst: 여왕 폐하와의 전투는 싸움이라 부를 수도 없어. 어떻게 그러겠어? 그 압도적인 힘에 누가 흠집이나 낼 수 있겠어?
Echoes of Change#441.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#442.src: This pile of trash has a strong stench of alcohol and other... unpleasantries.
Echoes of Change#442.dst: 이 쓰레기 더미에서 술 냄새와 다른... 불쾌한 냄새가 진동한다.

Echoes of Change#443.src: This must be the underwater route Yulie was talking about...
Echoes of Change#443.dst: 여기가 Yulie가 말한 물속 경로인 것 같다...

Echoes of Change#444.src: Second Division - Stationed by the gate to the {p}. Low risk - will assist in case of commotion.
Echoes of Change#444.dst: 제2분대 - {p} 관문 옆에 주둔. 위험도 낮음 - 소란 발생 시 지원.

Echoes of Change#445.src: - Tip! Hover over a piece and it will tell you its shape.
Echoes of Change#445.dst: - 팁! 조각에 마우스를 올리면 모양을 알려 줍니다.

Echoes of Change#446.src: ... So I must do this alone. If anyone must take the fall, it *will* be me.
Echoes of Change#446.dst: ...그러니 이건 나 혼자 해야 해. 누군가 책임져야 한다면, 그건 *반드시* 나야.
Echoes of Change#446.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#447.src: Because there is no other choice! Because if I am forced to bear yet another year without her by my side, then... then... then I think my spark would finally go out.
Echoes of Change#447.dst: 다른 선택지가 없으니까! 그녀 없이 또 한 해를 견뎌야 한다면, 그러면... 그러면... 내 안의 불씨가 마침내 꺼져 버릴 것 같아.
Echoes of Change#447.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#449.src: I suppose I may as well tell you. An anger without context must seem strange to an outside observer.
Echoes of Change#449.dst: 말해 두는 게 낫겠지. 사연 모를 분노는 밖에서 보면 이상해 보일 테니까.
Echoes of Change#449.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#450.src: I was once in the military, as you know. But I was no mere soldier, no... I'd risen so far as to approach Her Majesty's inner circle. One of her Wings.
Echoes of Change#450.dst: 알다시피 난 군에 있었어. 하지만 평범한 병사가 아니었지... 여왕 폐하의 측근 가까이까지 올라갔어. 폐하의 날개 중 하나였지.
Echoes of Change#450.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#451.src: You know, that was the year after Sovereign Selium died. The position for Sovereign of the {p} had opened up. If things had gone differently, could I have...?
Echoes of Change#451.dst: 그거 알아? 그건 Selium 군주가 죽은 이듬해였어. {p} 군주 자리가 비었지. 일이 달리 흘러갔다면, 내가...?
Echoes of Change#451.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#452.src: Maybe that's why she did it. She was always sending me on difficult assignments, but...
Echoes of Change#452.dst: 그래서 그랬을지도 몰라. 폐하는 늘 나에게 어려운 임무를 맡겼지만...
Echoes of Change#452.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#453.src: This time, I was ordered to deal with several cursed ones in the Roughworks. Capture if possible, but... well, they wouldn't always come quietly.
Echoes of Change#453.dst: 그때는 Roughworks의 저주받은 자 몇 명을 처리하라는 명령이었어. 가능하면 생포하되... 뭐, 늘 순순히 오진 않았지.
Echoes of Change#453.speaker: Syndra
